title: The Traditional Months
label: ch:te-traditional-months
canDo: I can name the twelve traditional Telugu months and say when Ugadi, the new year, falls.

payoff.summary: Recite Caitraṁ through Phālguṇaṁ, place Ugadi at Chaitra Śuddha Pādyami, and note the family split: Telugu and Kannada share Hindi's calendar, Tamil and Malayalam do not.
